questions.q: What does a test plan define before any testing begins?
options: The final go-live date only
Scope, testing levels, environments, roles, and entry/exit criteria
Only the list of defects found so far
The enterprise structure decisions
questions.explain: A test plan defines scope, the levels of testing, environments, responsible roles, and entry/exit criteria for each testing level before testing starts.

questions.q: What makes a test script useful to someone unfamiliar with the underlying requirement?
options: It has numbered steps specific enough that anyone could run it and get a meaningful result
It is written in vague, general terms
It skips the expected result to save time
It only needs a pass/fail outcome, no steps
questions.explain: Good test scripts are specific and repeatable — numbered steps with an expected result — so even someone unfamiliar with the requirement can run them and get a meaningful outcome.

questions.q: What should every test script trace back to?
options: A bank branch routing number
The Executive Sponsor's calendar
One or more requirement IDs in the Requirements Traceability Matrix
A Service Request severity level
questions.explain: Test scripts trace to requirement IDs in the RTM, closing the loop from requirement through configuration to proof that it works.

questions.q: Who typically writes test scripts for a module's processes?
options: The Executive Sponsor
The Functional Consultant for that module
Oracle Support
The OCM Lead
questions.explain: Functional Consultants typically write test scripts for their own module since they know both the requirement and the configuration behind it.

questions.q: What does Brightfield's test script CM-TS-07 verify?
options: That the project charter was signed
That the Technical Consultant resigned mid-project
That the chart of accounts has only one legal entity
That a wire transfer auto-match rule reconciles a matching transaction automatically after a statement import
questions.explain: CM-TS-07 traces to requirement BR-CM-014 and verifies that the auto-match rule reconciles a matching transaction with no manual intervention after a bank statement import.
